newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips jump to third record close in a row.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips jump to third record close in a row.

text.p: Blue chip stocks jumped to a third consecutive record finish on Tuesday, as foreign buying sparked by uncertainty over European monetary union helped the market overcome selling pressure.
According to early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average gained 60.77 points to end at 7,539.27, surpassing Monday's record of 7,478.50.
The Nasdaq index fell 10.33 points to 1,401.71.
